_source.table: List of mandatory and optional fields for the e-Invoice
_source.extraction: pdfplumber extract_tables() per page, cleaned by scripts/extract_fields.py; status is parsed from the [Optional] / [Mandatory, where ...] marker LHDN embeds in the field-name cell
_source.note: 'applies_to' is 'all' for every row: Appendix 1 is the general list. Self-billed and consolidated field variants live in Specific Guideline appendix tables and are not ingested yet.

fields.name: Supplier's Name
fields.description: Name of business or individual who will be the issuer of the e-Invoice in a commercial transaction

fields.name: Buyer's Name
fields.description: Name of recipient of the e-Invoice in a commercial transaction

fields.name: Supplier's TIN
fields.description: Supplier's (i.e., issuer's) TIN assigned by IRBM

fields.name: Supplier's Registration / Identification Number / Passport Number
fields.description: For businesses: BRN* For Malaysian individual: MyKad / MyTentera identification number For non-Malaysian individual: Passport number / MyPR / MyKAS identification number *BRN refers to the official registration number issued by the government, authorities or relevant bodies under which the taxpayer is registered, established or incorporated (e.g., taxpayers registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM) are required to only input the new BRN, which is 12-digit

fields.name: Supplier's SST Registration Number
fields.description: Sales tax / service tax (SST) registration number of the Supplier *This is not applicable to Suppliers that are not SST-registered

fields.name: Supplier's Tourism Tax Registration Number
fields.description: Tourism tax registration number of the Supplier. This is only applicable to tourism tax registrant, which may consist of hotel operators and online travel operators

fields.name: Supplier's e-mail
fields.description: E-mail address of the Supplier

fields.name: Supplier's Malaysia Standard Industrial Classification (MSIC) Code
fields.description: 5-digit numeric code that represent the Supplier's business nature and activity

fields.name: Supplier's Business Activity Description
fields.description: Description of the Supplier's business activity

fields.name: Buyer's TIN
fields.description: Buyer's TIN assigned by IRBM

fields.name: Buyer's Registration / Identification Number / Passport Number
fields.description: For businesses: BRN* For Malaysian individual: MyKad / MyTentera identification number For non-Malaysian individual: Passport number / MyPR / MyKAS identification number *BRN refers to the official registration number issued by the government, authorities or relevant bodies under which the taxpayer is registered, established or incorporated (e.g., taxpayers registered with the Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM) are required to only input the new BRN, which is 12-digit characters). For taxpayers who does not possess a BRN, any identification number may be assigned by the IRBM as deemed appropriate.

fields.name: Buyer's SST Registration Number
fields.description: SST registration number of the Buyer *This is not applicable to Buyers that are not SST-registered

fields.name: Buyer's e-mail
fields.description: E-mail address of the Buyer

fields.name: Supplier's Address
fields.description: Address (registered, business, residential, etc.) of business or individual who will be the issuer of the e-Invoice in a commercial transaction

fields.name: Buyer's Address
fields.description: Address (registered, business, residential, etc.) of recipient of the e-Invoice in a commercial transaction

fields.name: Supplier's Contact Number
fields.description: The telephone number of the Supplier (e.g., office, mobile, fax)

fields.name: Buyer's Contact Number
fields.description: The telephone number of the Buyer (e.g., office, mobile, fax)

fields.name: e-Invoice Version
fields.description: Current e-Invoice version (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, etc.)

fields.name: e-Invoice Type
fields.description: Identifies the document type (e.g., invoice, credit note, debit note, refund note, etc.)

fields.name: e-Invoice Code / Number
fields.description: Document reference number used by Supplier for internal tracking purpose (e.g., INV12345, CN23456, DN34567)

fields.name: Original e-Invoice Reference Number
fields.description: IRBM Unique Identifier Number of original invoice / document that is being affected / adjusted. Applicable where a debit note, credit note or refund note e-Invoice is issued

fields.name: e-Invoice Date and Time
fields.description: Date and time of issuance of the e-Invoice *Note that the date and time must be the current date and time

fields.name: Issuer's Digital Signature
fields.description: Anelectronic signature to ensure integrity and non-repudiation of documents. The e-Invoice shall be signed using issuer's digital certificate. In the event where taxpayers utilise the services of service provider, the e-Invoice shall be signed using service provider's digital certificate. Please refer to the SDK for more details on digital certificate.

fields.name: Invoice Currency Code
fields.description: Specific currency that is used to represent the monetary value stated in the e-Invoice

fields.name: Currency Exchange Rate
fields.description: Rate at which non-Malaysian currency will be converted into Malaysian Ringgit

fields.name: Frequency of Billing
fields.description: Frequency of the invoice (e.g., Daily, Weekly, Biweekly, Monthly, Bimonthly, Quarterly, Half-yearly, Yearly, Others / Not Applicable)

fields.name: Billing Period
fields.description: Interval of the transaction (e.g., 2025-01-01 – 2025-01-31)

fields.name: Classification
fields.description: Category of products or services being billed as a result of a commercial transaction (e.g., general expenses, medical expenses, donations, self-billed e-Invoice, etc.)

fields.name: Description of Product or Service
fields.description: Details of products or services being billed as a result of a commercial transaction

fields.name: Unit Price
fields.description: Price assigned to a single unit of a product or service

fields.name: Tax Type
fields.description: Type of taxes that will be applicable (e.g., sales tax, service tax, tourism tax, etc.), applicable for both line item and invoice level

fields.name: Tax Rate
fields.description: The appropriate tax rate (be it in the form of percentage (%) or prevailing specified rate) that is applicable

fields.name: Tax Amount
fields.description: The amount of tax payable, applicable for both line item and invoice level

fields.name: Details of Tax Exemption
fields.condition: Mandatory if tax exemption is applicable
fields.description: Description of tax exemption applicable (e.g., Buyer's sales tax exemption certificate number, special exemption as per gazette orders, etc.)

fields.name: Amount Exempted from Tax
fields.condition: Mandatory if tax exemption is applicable
fields.description: Total amount of tax exempted for sales tax or service tax purposes

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.description: Amount of each individual item/ service within the invoice, excluding any taxes, charges or discounts, applicable for line item only

fields.name: Total Excluding Tax
fields.description: Sum of amount payable (inclusive of applicable discounts and charges), excluding any applicable taxes (e.g., sales tax, service tax). This data field is applicable for both line item and invoice level.

fields.name: Total Including Tax
fields.description: Sum of amount payable inclusive of total taxes chargeable (e.g., sales tax, service tax), applicable for invoice level only

fields.name: Total Net Amount
fields.description: Sum of total amount payable (inclusive of applicable line item and invoice level discounts and charges), excluding any applicable taxes (e.g., sales tax, service tax). This data field is applicable for invoice level only.

fields.name: Total Payable Amount
fields.description: Sum of amount payable (inclusive of total taxes chargeable and any rounding adjustment) excluding any amount paid in advance, applicable at invoice level only

fields.name: Rounding Amount
fields.description: Rounding amount added to the amount payable, applicable at invoice level only

fields.name: Total Taxable Amount Per Tax Type
fields.description: Sum of amount chargeable for each tax type, applicable for invoice level only

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units of a particular product or service in a commercial transaction

fields.name: Measurement
fields.description: Standard unit or system used to measure the product or service

fields.name: Discount Rate
fields.description: Percentage of deduction from the original price of a product or service, applicable for line level and invoice level

fields.name: Discount Amount
fields.description: Amount deducted from the original price of a product or service, applicable for line level and invoice level

fields.name: Fee / Charge Rate
fields.description: Charge associated with the product or service (be it in the form of percentage (%) or prevailing specified rate), applicable for both line item and invoice level

fields.name: Fee / Charge Amount
fields.description: Charge associated with the product or service, applicable for both line item and invoice level

fields.name: Payment Mode
fields.description: Chosen mechanism through which funds are transferred from buyer to supplier (e.g., cash, cheque, bank transfer, credit card, debit card, e-Wallet / Digital Wallet, etc.)

fields.name: Supplier's Bank Account Number
fields.description: The Supplier's bank account number to facilitate payment by Buyer

fields.name: Payment Terms
fields.description: Anagreed-upon payment terms and conditions e.g., timing and method of payment

fields.name: Prepayment Amount
fields.description: Monetary value that is prepaid by the Buyer in order to fulfill the financial obligation

fields.name: Prepayment Date
fields.description: Date of prepayment received

fields.name: Prepayment Reference Number
fields.description: Unique identifier assigned to trace prepayment

fields.name: Bill Reference Number
fields.description: Supplier's internal billing reference number to facilitate payment from Buyer
